scientific_integrity: Exhaustive equality-pattern census on five symbols, a support-collapsing all-alphabet argument, constructive de Bruijn witnesses, and independent direct finite tests are supplied. No external independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact earliest saturation length is bounded, not determined; the result covers one deletion of linear words and oriented contiguous three-gram histograms. Comparison to a highly relevant September 2026 substring-count paper was limited to public summaries because its full text was inaccessible.
title: Sharp q-ary one-deletion trigram-profile capacity and saturation witnesses
